description: This file defines a final utility class `IndexFactory` in the package `org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.persistence.mongo.indices`. The class provides static methods to create various instances of `Index`, used for managing MongoDB index configurations, including default, custom, and expiration indexes. It employs Java Stream API for processing index keys and encapsulates index creation logic, such as background indexing and expiration settings.

classes.name: IndexFactory
classes.description: A utility factory class for creating various MongoDB Index instances with different configurations.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a default ascending index with optional uniqueness and sparsity based on the provided fields and name.

methods.name: newInstanceWithCustomKeys
methods.description: Creates an index with custom keys, allowing detailed control over index key configuration, uniqueness, and sparsity.

methods.name: newExpirationIndex
methods.description: Generates a background index for document expiration based on a time-encoded field.
